question: Padma Bhushan and Sangeet Natak Akademi award winner Rukmini Devi Arundale was an exponent of _________ .
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Bharatanatyam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Rukmini Devi Arundale** was a renowned proponent of **Bharatanatyam**, one of the classical dance forms of India.
 
• She is credited with **reviving Bharatanatyam** during the 20th century, transforming it from a temple dance to a respected art form performed on stage.
 
• Bharatanatyam originated in Tamil Nadu and is deeply rooted in **Indian spiritual traditions**, especially the **Hindu religion**.
